unlisted_practices: Knowledge-grounded multi-agent LLM framework that uses external clinical knowledge and safety verification (drug interactions, contraindications) to recommend traceable medication sets
Evaluating medication recommendation at fine-grained fourth-level ATC code granularity rather than broad drug categories

screen.reason: The paper introduces and benchmarks a novel multi-agent LLM framework (SafeRx-Agent) incorporating knowledge grounding and safety verification for medication recommendation on retrospective MIMIC datasets. Developing and testing a new agent architecture on a benchmark does not test an organizational deployment practice.
